title: Spyro's Easter Egg Hunt
description: Hide colourful Easter Eggs for your friends to find. Make it a fun event for the whole server.  Survival friendly and with a leader-board.
body:
![Easter Eggs in all colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71fe30e3cc84b8f1577ce7d287cb2ba5ee89cfb2.jpeg)
## Hide colorful Easter Eggs for your friends to find.

Craft Easter Eggs with one egg and any kind of dye.
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06127c9ead78a350657773b87636a51d4045ff8e.png)
Or use this command to get one egg in each color:

```
/function easter_eggs:get_all_eggs
```

Easter Eggs can be placed in the world with right click.
Placed Easter Eggs can be opened with right click.
Placed Easter Eggs can be mined with left click.

## Settings:
![Setting Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d13c8a9209d66234909af30e1c55e1bf835f220d_0.webp)
Use this command to open settings:
```
/function easter_eggs:settings
```


### Egg Hunt: (default:On)
When false, all Easter Eggs are invisible. Only the owner of an Easter Egg sees particles where it is. Easter Eggs can be placed and mined like normal. Easter Eggs can not be collected.

### Mine other Players Easter Eggs: (default:Off)
When false, only the player who has placed the Easter Egg can also mine it.

### Collect own Easter Eggs: (default:Off)
When false, only other players who have not placed the Easter Egg can collect it.

### Show Easter Eggs Scoreboard: (default:Off)
When true, _Collected Easter Eggs Scoreboard_ is displayed.

### Show Easter Eggs Left: (default:On)
When true, _Collected Easter Eggs Scoreboard_ shows how many uncollected Easter Eggs are left.

### Reset Settings
Sets Settings back to default.

### Reset Egg Count
Sets _Collected Easter Eggs_ from all players back to 0.
